subtitle: Two Standards
briefing: Roots have closed the charted bank route. Keep Orra and Mares alive while the other crew reaches the inlet. A unit at either standard can call the forward reserve to that bank; the reserve can answer only once.

victory.text: Every swimmer through. I would have left half of them behind if I had kept to my own orders.
Then we use one set of orders now. The inlet reaches the other side of the willow.
My crew will follow you there. Clear the spring, and the company is yours.

debrief: The watch withdraws together through the inlet. Mares gives Orra field command for the assault on the willow; the permanent captaincy still depends on breaking the Mother’s hold on the spring.
